values.value: The core Nut command is at the start of the chain. Each Parameter filter acts as a numerical gateway for more specific results based off numeric input with the core command.To add a new nut redeem and tie it to a specific number, create a parameter filter and follow the prescribed parameter structure. Once done, connect the gateway parameter filter to the second output in the ordered execution node below. Have fun!

1. Import the prop to your vnyan scene
2. Import the redeems.json to your node graph.

The current node setup will trigger the lights afer recieving the !tree message. !tree randomly sets a LightPattern and LightColor value. Lights are set to turn off the lights after <lightDuration> by setting LightPattern to 0.

----------------
-- Parameters --
----------------

LightPattern - 0 - Off
LightPattern - 1 - Solid
LightPattern - 2 - Blink
LightPattern - 3 - Stream

lightColor - 1 - White
lightColor - 2 - RedOn
lightColor - 3 - BlueOn 
lightColor - 4 - GreenOn 
lightColor - 5 - YellowOn 
lightColor - 6 - CandyCane
lightColor - 7 - Icicle
lightColor - 8 - Rainbow/Festive
